newsitem.title: CHINA: China electronics market to top 1.0 trillion yuan.
newsitem.headline: China electronics market to top 1.0 trillion yuan.

text.p: China's market potential for electronic products is expected to top one trillion yuan in the year 2000, and six trillion yuan just 10 years later, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
China has a huge market for electronic products, with annual growth as high as 30 percent expected, a national meeting on electronics industry heard at its opening on Wednesday, Xinhua said.
China's electronics industry is aiming to achieve gross output value of 360 billion yuan in 1997, up 20 percent compared with last year, Xinhua said.
The industry will reap total sales of 240 billion yuan this year, up 23 percent and earn $24 billion from exports, up 15 percent, it said.
In 1996, the electronics industry scored gross output value of 298.2 billion yuan, up 20.7 percent and reported sales of 194.7 billion yuan, up 18 percent.
Output of items such as computers and telecommunications equipment shot up 40 percent last year, it said.
Total foreign trade for the industry hit $34.63 billion in 1996, with January-November exports at $18.97 billion, it said.
